::: {#rem-compute-optimal}

#### Spending a compute budget

For a fixed number of FLOPs,
a larger model sees fewer tokens.
@hoffmann2022training trained over 400 [language model](language-models.qmd#def-language-model)s to find the best split,
and found that the number of [parameter](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-parameter)s and the number of tokens should grow equally:
each doubling of model size should come with a doubling of the tokens.
Chinchilla's `r py$tokens_per_param` tokens per parameter follow that rule,
and it outperformed Gopher,
a model 4 times its size trained with the same compute on fewer tokens [@hoffmann2022training].

:::
